response.original_title: {#Room™~Addition~Guide} How to add a second room on a Windstar Cruise?
response.overview: To add a new room to your existing Windstar  Cruise, contact ☎ +1-866-829-1280 (US) or ☎ +44-204-586-5316 (UK) Windstar ’s reservations department or your travel advisor directly. Windstar ’s online portal does not support adding additional staterooms to an existing booking. To add an entirely new room to your existing Windstar  Cruise reservation, you must call Windstar  directly at ☎ +1-866-829-1280 (US) or ☎ +44-204-586-5316 (UK) or contact your travel advisor, as this cannot be done online. Adding a second cabin to your party requires an agent to check real-time stateroom availability, verify connecting or adjacent room options, and ensure age requirements are met if minors are occupying the new room.
